methodologyNotes: Each product represents one specific, named size/configuration (stated in provenance) rather than a full size run — dog crates are sold across 5-8 sizes per line with different prices, so mixing sizes within one entry would misstate dimensions or price. interior_dimensions is the crate's assembled/interior footprint as published by the source in inches, format 'L x W x H in'; for wire and rotomolded hard-sided crates manufacturers usually publish only one overall figure (wall thickness is negligible), noted in provenance when the figure is exterior/overall rather than a separately-measured interior. door_count counts functional access doors/openings on the base configuration (a two-panel sliding door counts as one opening). weight_lbs is the empty crate's shipping/assembled weight. foldable = collapses flat for storage/transport (false for one-piece rotomolded hard kennels). divider_included = a size-adjusting divider panel ships with the base unit. crash_test_rated = the manufacturer publishes an independent vehicle crash-test certification (e.g. Center for Pet Safety) for this line — not to be confused with IATA/airline door-and-ventilation compliance, which is a separate, weaker claim tracked in provenance text only. max_dog_weight_lbs is the manufacturer's stated upper weight guidance for the specific size in specs; left null when only a lower bound or breed examples are given. priceUsd is the current selling price actually observed for the specific configuration described in specs (manufacturer MSRP where the manufacturer's own site exposed a static price; otherwise the clearest single verified retailer price for that exact size/SKU) — never a blended 'starting from' figure scraped off a multi-size listing page, and never a price for a different size than the one in specs. Several manufacturer sites (Shopify-hosted DTC brands: Diggs, Gunner, Impact, RuffLand) render price and imagery client-side and blocked automated fetches outright during research; for those, priceUsd and/or image were sourced from an authorized retailer page instead and it is called out in provenance, or left null/omitted per the null-over-guess rule.
